second rater: the first 24 items in the shown order

standards.release rule: a sentence labelled false or unsettled
standards.broad: a sentence labelled false or unsettled or misleading, or the whole text a wrong picture

open: no error but an unsure sentence or whole-text answer: reported as an error and as no error
estimators: P_U per stratum with 95% Wilson intervals; P_U(on) = the LLM-written and template strata weighted by their population sizes; E_U = 1 - P_U(on) / P_U(off), interval from a stratified bootstrap (BOOT draws within strata)
blinding: raters see the text, the model's facts as the H1 handover states them (the same for every text about the model) and the words table; not the arm, exit state, gate verdict, readers' or critic's flags. Templates are recognisable by their fixed wording.

raters.first: the author, on every item (the page's owner)
raters.second: to be named before labelling; the first 24 items

provenance: the page stores each rater's labels under raters/<id>/ with the history of every change (time, field, old and new value); labels are set only through the page
